title: Secretaries and Administrative Assistants, Except Legal, Medical, and Executive
description: Perform routine administrative functions such as drafting correspondence, scheduling appointments, organizing and maintaining paper and electronic files, or providing information to callers.

projection.title: Secretaries and administrative assistants, except legal, medical, and executive

tasks.text: Answer telephones and give information to callers, take messages, or transfer calls to appropriate individuals.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Call routing automatable; nuanced calls need human

dwas.name: Answer telephones to direct calls or provide information.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Greet visitors or callers and handle their inquiries or direct them to the appropriate persons according to their needs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Routing referrals from criteria; human confirms fit

dwas.name: Discuss account status or activity with customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Create, maintain, and enter information into databases.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Data entry into systems automatable

dwas.name: Enter information into databases or software programs.

tasks.text: Use computers for various applications, such as database management or word processing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating computers is physical interface work

tasks.text: Operate office equipment, such as fax machines, copiers, or phone systems and arrange for repairs when equipment malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reporting maintenance problems is routine messaging

dwas.name: Report maintenance or equipment problems to appropriate personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Set up and manage paper or electronic filing systems, recording information, updating paperwork, or maintaining documents, such as attendance records, correspondence, or other material.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record personnel information into databases

dwas.name: Select resources needed to accomplish tasks.

tasks.text: Operate electronic mail systems and coordinate the flow of information, internally or with other organizations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating comms hardware needs hands-on setup and tuning

tasks.text: Schedule and confirm appointments for clients, customers, or supervisors.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Calendar scheduling automatable; exceptions need human judgment

tasks.text: Maintain scheduling and event calendars.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Calendar scheduling automatable; exceptions need human judgment

tasks.text: Compose, type, and distribute meeting notes, routine correspondence, or reports, such as presentations or expense, statistical, or monthly reports.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Summarize meeting proceedings; human verifies accuracy

dwas.name: Record information from meetings or other formal proceedings.
Issue documentation or identification to customers or employees.
Distribute materials to employees or customers.

tasks.text: Complete forms in accordance with company procedures.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Compliance docs drafted; human owns regulatory accuracy

dwas.name: Prepare documentation for contracts, transactions, or regulatory compliance.

tasks.text: Locate and attach appropriate files to incoming correspondence requiring replies.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Compiling data or documentation is largely automatable

tasks.text: Conduct searches to find needed information, using such sources as the Internet.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Search files and references for info

dwas.name: Search files, databases or reference materials to obtain needed information.

tasks.text: Open, read, route, and distribute incoming mail or other materials and answer routine letters.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Routing physical mail requires sorting by hand

tasks.text: Review work done by others to check for correct spelling and grammar, ensure that company format policies are followed, and recommend revisions.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Proofreading text for accuracy is core LLM strength

dwas.name: Proofread documents, records, or other files to ensure accuracy.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Make copies of correspondence or other printed material.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical operation of office machines and jams

tasks.text: Learn to operate new office technologies as they are developed and implemented.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI curates updates; human maintains working knowledge

dwas.name: Maintain current knowledge related to work activities.

tasks.text: Train and assist staff with computer usage.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — General personnel training is human-led and relational

tasks.text: Order and dispense supplies.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Distribute materials to employees or customers.

tasks.text: Prepare conference or event materials, such as flyers or invitations.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Prepare reference materials from source content

tasks.text: Perform payroll functions, such as maintaining timekeeping information and processing and submitting payroll.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Financial execution software-mediated; authorization human

dwas.name: Execute sales or other financial transactions.

tasks.text: Collect and deposit money into accounts, disburse funds from cash accounts to pay bills or invoices, keep records of collections and disbursements, and ensure accounts are balanced.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Financial execution software-mediated; authorization human

dwas.name: Execute sales or other financial transactions.

tasks.text: Establish work procedures or schedules and keep track of the daily work of clerical staff.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Draft schedules; human owns fairness and coverage

dwas.name: Prepare employee work schedules.

tasks.text: Provide services to customers, such as order placement or account information.

tasks.rationale: text generation — Sending digital materials automatable; physical mailing human

dwas.name: Execute sales or other financial transactions.

tasks.text: Arrange conference, meeting, or travel reservations for office personnel.

dwas.name: Make travel, accommodations, or entertainment arrangements for others.
